pairs.why: A's clear cyan-rimmed bell and long, flowing ribbon arms match the real jellyfish's soft, trailing look better than B's short, bunched ruffles.
B is a plain dark-navy can light with three lenses, like the real card, while A adds bulky barn-door flaps the real lamp doesn't have.
A's yellow trim and swollen, toy-like parts move away from the real lamp's plain dark-navy metal, and B keeps that clean, neatly built look.
Both lamps have nearly the same dark-navy body, glowing lenses and light finish; they differ mainly in truss angle, which shouldn't decide the call.
B is flatter and crisper with cleaner, bigger green areas, closer to the real neat sheets than A's wavier, more papery, more detailed map.
B's bright green sheets with clean, light-cream borders match the real card's main colours, while A reads as soft, old beige paper, though B's edges are a bit thick.
B's sheets are flatter and more upright, with wide green fields and lighter borders closer to the real card, while A is a beige, wavy, folded paper map.
Like the real umbrella, B has a thin pole, a visible underside and crisp, softly shaded panels, while A is chunky and glossy with a thick, toy-like pole.
